stable.zh: 一个稳定的政府可以追求长期的政策，而不必担心失去权力。

stable.en: Internationally, Canada has a reputation as a stable democracy and as a middle power.
stable.zh: 在国际上，加拿大享有稳定民主政体和中等强国的声誉。

stable.en: Children born into poverty often lack good education, safe housing, and stable jobs.
stable.zh: 出生在贫困中的儿童往往缺乏良好的教育、安全的住房和稳定的工作。

stable.en: I would spend hours on end sitting in a stable with my pony.
stable.zh: 我会连续几个小时坐在马厩里陪着我的小马。

strict.en: Berlin tried strict rent controls, had to partially reverse them, but maintained some protections.
strict.zh: 柏林尝试过严格的租金管制，不得不部分撤回，但保留了一些保护措施。

strict.en: The word picky is used to describe someone who is too strict about rules.
strict.zh: Picky 这个词用来形容对规则过于严苛的人。

strict.en: There were food shortages, strict rationing and inflation that affected millions of civilians.
strict.zh: 出现了粮食短缺、严格的配给制和通货膨胀，影响了数百万平民。

strict.en: And they began to enforce strict rules—rules that seemed to come out of nowhere.
strict.zh: 他们还开始执行一些严苛的规矩——那些规矩似乎凭空冒出来的。

strict.en: Prussia developed a reputation for strict organization and strong leadership and a military culture.
strict.zh: 普鲁士以严明的组织、强大的领导力和军事文化而闻名。

stack.en: There are stacks of used wooden pallets and big reels for holding wires.
stack.zh: 这里有一堆堆用过的木托盘和用来装电线的巨大卷轴。

stack.en: If you're stacking a lot of things on top of each other, each one of those things becomes less important.
stack.zh: 如果你堆砌了太多东西，每一项的重要性都会被稀释。

stack.en: And so it's like, we have this big stack of should do's and we just wait until it's two miles.
stack.zh: 所以这就好像，我们有一大堆该做却没做的事，我们就一直拖着，直到堆得有两英里高。

stack.en: And then that allowed me to start giving myself a stack of undeniable proof that I am who I wanted to be.
stack.zh: 我不相信二元特征，意思是说：他要么有耐心，要么没耐心，要么忠诚，要么不忠诚。

stack.en: A codex is a series of handwritten pages of text which are then stacked on top of each other and bound along one side.
stack.zh: 手抄本是一系列手写的文字页，然后将它们叠放在一起，沿着一边装订。

stock.en: The NASDAQ Stock Index, which included many tech companies, lost nearly 80% of its value.
stock.zh: 纳斯达克股票指数包含了许多科技公司，其价值损失了近80%。

stock.en: Because now, you and I are being patient for your stock investments.
stock.zh: 因为现在，你和我正在为你的股票投资保持耐心。

stock.en: You need to stock up. Stock up now. You need these things.
stock.zh: 你需要囤货。马上囤货。你需要这些东西。

stock.en: You need to stock up. Stock up now. You need these things.
stock.zh: 你需要囤货。马上囤货。你需要这些东西。

stock.en: You You just lose, you know, if the stock goes to zero, you double your money.
stock.zh: 你只是输了，你知道，如果股票跌到零，你就赚了一倍的钱。

stimulate.en: The verb to stimulate means encourage it or cause it to develop and grow.
stimulate.zh: 动词stimulate意思是鼓励或促使其发展和生长。

stimulate.en: And finally, to stimulate means to encourage something or cause it to grow.
stimulate.zh: 最后，stimulate意思是鼓励某事或促使其生长。

stimulate.en: If low-wage workers have more money in their pockets, they are likely to spend it in their local communities, which helps stimulate the economy.
stimulate.zh: 如果低收入工人兜里有更多的钱，他们很可能会在当地社区消费，这有助于刺激经济。

stimulate.en: Not having the sense that anything is missing in this moment. needing something to change your current positive situation being contingent on an adjustment on getting something from the outside world ironically i think most people if you were to ask them when they were happiest for a sustained period of time not for a brief moment because pleasure can override happiness and create kind of this illusion of happiness but if you ask people when they were happy for a sustained period of time they were probably doing some variation of nothing that's interesting because in the chase is this sort of lack this contingency that's right but then you get bored if you just sit around all the time you get bored so you want adventure you want surprise like there's the funny thought experiment of the bliss machine right which is suppose i could drill a hole in your head and put an electrode in and they did this with monkeys and i can put a wire in there and i can stimulate just the right part of your brain and I can put you in bliss and you'll just be in bliss.
stimulate.zh: 没有那种在这一刻缺少什么的感觉。不需要任何东西来改变你当前的积极状况，这种状况取决于调整，取决于从外部世界获得什么。讽刺的是，我认为大多数人，如果你问他们什么时候最快乐，在一段持续的时间里，而不是短暂的瞬间，因为快乐可以覆盖幸福并创造一种幸福的错觉，但如果你问人们什么时候在一段持续的时间里感到快乐，他们可能在做某种形式的“什么都不做”。这很有趣，因为在追求中存在这种缺乏，这种偶然性，没错。但如果你一直坐着，你会感到无聊，所以你想要冒险，你想要惊喜，就像那个关于“极乐机器”的有趣思想实验，对吧？假设我可以在你的头上钻个洞，放一个电极进去，他们对猴子做过这个，我可以在那里放一根电线，我可以刺激你大脑中正确的部分，我可以让你处于极乐状态，你就会一直处于极乐状态。

strike.en: If you're struck by an idea, you find it particularly interesting or impressive.
strike.zh: 如果你对某个想法感到 struck，意思就是你觉得它特别有意思或令人印象深刻。

strike.en: Other men would get struck down within days or even hours of setting foot into the Amazon.
strike.zh: 其他人一踏入亚马逊，几天甚至几小时内就会被击倒。

strike.en: Host of the programme Graihagh Jackson is struck by what Jyoti says.
strike.zh: 节目主持人 Graihagh Jackson 对 Jyoti 的话印象深刻(struck)。

strike.en: I'm always struck by the Elon Musk story where he did PayPal as x.com originally, actually.
strike.zh: 埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）的故事总是让我印象深刻，他最初把PayPal叫做 x.com。

strike.en: Lightning strikes a dry tree. A lava flow ignites grassland.
strike.zh: 闪电击中干燥的树木。熔岩流点燃了草原。

statue.en: How were these enormous statues moved across the island without wheels, tools, or animals?
statue.zh: 在没有轮子、工具或动物的情况下，这些巨大的石像是如何在岛上被运送的呢？

statue.en: The most famous landmark in the city is the statue of Christ the Redeemer.
statue.zh: 这座城市最著名的地标是救世主基督像。

statue.en: From the British Museum’s perspective, their Moai statue is an important part of global heritage.
statue.zh: 从大英博物馆的角度来看，他们的 Moai 雕像是全球遗产的重要组成部分。

statue.en: It is. It’s an amazing statue. But you’re comparing two different things, right?
statue.zh: 它是。这是一座令人惊叹的雕像。但你在比较两个不同的东西，对吧？

statue.en: These included castles and temples. There were statues, pyramids, and ancient cities.
statue.zh: 其中包括城堡和寺庙，也有雕像、金字塔和古城。

steal.en: And because it was soft, warm, and ready to eat, it could also be stolen.
steal.zh: 而且因为它又软、又热、随时可以食用，它也很容易被偷走。

steal.en: They stole livestock in Mexico and sold it on the American side of the border.
steal.zh: 他们在墨西哥偷牲畜，然后拿到美国一侧的边境贩卖。

steal.en: Indeed, in 1970, he is estimated to have stolen 60% of the entire country’s annual budget.
steal.zh: 事实上，据估计，仅在1970年他就盗用了全国年度预算的60%。

steal.en: Only if you steal so much as to become rich overnight, you will be caught.”
steal.zh: “只有当你偷得太多以至于一夜暴富时，你才会被抓。”

steal.en: In the past, many artefacts have been looted – or stolen by force.
steal.zh: 在过去，许多文物被掠夺，或者通过暴力被盗走。

stone.en: Stones from Aztec temples were used to construct churches and palaces and government buildings.
stone.zh: 阿兹特克神庙的石头被用来建造教堂、宫殿和政府大楼。

stone.en: It’s constructed from white marble and decorated with intricate carvings, calligraphy, and precious stones.
stone.zh: 它由白大理石建造，饰有复杂的雕刻、书法和宝石。

stone.en: Transporting stone and building large temples in such a difficult environment is a challenge.
stone.zh: 在如此困难的环境中运输石头并建造大型寺庙是一个巨大的挑战。

stone.en: It is the winter of 1837. A small boy stands in a large stone hall.
stone.zh: 那是 1837 年的冬天。一个瘦小的男孩站在宽大的石头大厅里。

stone.en: And some once had large red stone hats that were placed on top.
stone.zh: 有些石像的顶部曾经还戴着巨大的红色石帽。

stew.en: David tasted perpetual stew, a pot into which ingredients are placed and cooked continuously.
stew.zh: 大卫品尝了永生炖菜，这是一个不断放入食材并持续烹饪的锅。

stew.en: Pies and stews, puddings, and dishes that could feed an entire family.
stew.zh: 馅饼、炖菜、布丁，以及能喂饱全家人的菜肴。

stew.en: A common meal might be a type of vegetable stew called pottage.
stew.zh: 常见的一餐可能是一种叫做 pottage 的蔬菜炖汤。

stew.en: Ah, I asked you what the main ingredient is in the Bangkok stew, and you said vegetables.
stew.zh: 啊，我问你曼谷炖菜的主要成分是什么，你说是蔬菜。

strictly.en: If something is not strictly true, it's not completely or entirely true.
strictly.zh: 如果某事不是严格意义上的真实（not strictly true），那它就不是完全或绝对真实。

strictly.en: And that when you activate what we would think of as a strictly cognitive activity, you're also activating the emotion side of things.
strictly.zh: 而且，当你激活一项我们通常认为纯属认知的活动时，你同时也在激活大脑中与情绪相关的那些区域。

strictly.en: Wow, that is a long time! Fuchsia doesn't know if it's strictly true, or completely true, that the same stew has really lasted 100 years, but she thinks it's possible in theory, as long as it's kept safe and hygienic through boiling.
strictly.zh: 哇，那真是太久了！扶霞不知道同一锅炖菜真的持续了100年是否完全属实，但她认为在理论上是可能的，只要通过煮沸保持安全和卫生。

stream.en: One is Border Districts. The other Stream System-- The Collected Short Fiction of Gerald Murnane.
stream.zh: 一部是《边境地区》。另一部是《溪流系统——Gerald Murnane短篇小说集》。

stream.en: But smartphones and streaming apps make audiobooks much more convenient.
stream.zh: 但智能手机和流媒体应用让有声书变得更加方便。

stream.en: All of this stuff, headlines, 24 hours a day stream directly into your consciousness through a device in your pocket.
stream.zh: 所有这些东西，头条新闻，每天24小时通过你口袋里的设备直接流向你的意识。

stream.en: It's a huge monthly stream of money, which is expected to come in for the next 30 years, the life of a mortgage.
stream.zh: 这是一笔巨大的月度现金流，预计在未来 30 年（抵押贷款的生命周期）内源源不断地流入。

stream.en: Well, one of the first things the child's got to do is, they've got to break down the speech stream into words.
stream.zh: 嗯，孩子要做的第一件事之一，就是他们必须把语音流分解成单词。

statistics.en: Their income is unstable, unpredictable, and often invisible in official statistics.
statistics.zh: 他们的收入不稳定、不可预测，并且在官方统计中往往是隐形的。

statistics.en: He seems to be more interested in outcomes than statistics.
statistics.zh: 他似乎对实际结果比对统计数据更感兴趣。

statistics.en: I found some statistics online from Transparency International.
statistics.zh: 我在网上找到了一些来自“透明国际”的统计数据。

statistics.en: Economists and statistics experts repeatedly proved that the number was misleading and wrong, but the emotional impact of the claim had already taken hold.
statistics.zh: 经济学家和统计专家多次证明这个数字具有误导性且是错误的，但该主张带来的情感冲击已经扎根。

statistics.en: Rather than talking about economic statistics a lot, Burnham tends to speak about whether people can go to work easily or find affordable homes or receive good healthcare.
statistics.zh: 比起大谈经济数据，Burnham往往更愿意谈论人们是否能轻松去上班、找到负担得起的住房或获得良好的医疗服务。

stereotype.en: These stereotypes suggest that poverty is the result of bad choices or weak character.
stereotype.zh: 这些刻板印象暗示贫困是不良选择或性格薄弱的结果。

stereotype.en: Nuala discusses stereotypes about siblings, a word that means either brother or sister.
stereotype.zh: 努拉讨论了关于兄弟姐妹（sibling）的刻板印象，“sibling”这个词既可以指兄弟也可以指姐妹。

stereotype.en: And this is actually partly where the stereotype of British food becoming bad comes from.
stereotype.zh: 这实际上也是英国食物“难吃”这一刻板印象的部分来源。

stereotype.en: One stereotype is that the older sister is usually bossy – she enjoys telling people what to do.
stereotype.zh: 其中一种刻板印象是，大姐通常很专横——她喜欢指挥别人做事。

stereotype.en: This stereotype is not completely new. British people themselves have made jokes about their country’s food for years.
stereotype.zh: 这种刻板印象并不是什么新鲜事。英国人自己多年来也一直在拿自己国家的食物开玩笑。

storage.en: People begin to record information, either through writing or other systems of storage.
storage.zh: 人们开始记录信息，无论是通过文字还是其他存储系统。

storage.en: The city included agricultural sites, temples, homes, storage areas, water channels.
storage.zh: 这座城市包括农业区、寺庙、住宅、仓储区、水渠。

storage.en: It is in the final stages of opening a nuclear storage site deep underground that will be able to safely store nuclear waste for 100,000 years.
storage.zh: 它正处于在地下深处启用一个核存储库的最后阶段，该存储库将能够安全地储存核废料长达10万年。

storage.en: According to a tablet from 5000 years ago, we know Kushim was responsible for the production and storage of barley, and he signed his name on his tablet.
storage.zh: 根据一块5年前的泥板，我们知道库什姆负责大麦的生产和储存，他在自己的泥板上签了名。

storage.en: But we also need to sleep after we've learnt new things because that's when our brain consolidates the information - takes it from short-term storage to long-term storage, fits it in with other things we already know, that old adage of if you've got a problem sleep on it, your brain does actually work on things during the night, and you can often wake up and have solved the problem in your sleep.
storage.zh: 但我们在学到新东西后也需要睡觉，因为那是大脑巩固信息的时候——把信息从短期存储转移到长期存储，把它和我们已经知道的其他事情结合起来，就像那句老话说的，如果你遇到了问题，睡一觉再说，你的大脑实际上确实会在夜间处理事情，你经常一觉醒来就会在睡梦中解决问题。

stadium.en: Today’s sports stadiums and arenas still use similar ideas to manage their audiences.
stadium.zh: 今天的体育场馆和竞技场仍然使用类似的想法来管理观众。

stadium.en: And the stadium was full of Australians wearing their country’s flag.
stadium.zh: 体育场里到处都是身穿国旗服饰的澳大利亚人。

stadium.en: Hillsborough was a disaster in which 97 Liverpool football fans lost their lives during a stadium crush in 1989.
stadium.zh: 希尔斯堡惨剧是一场悲剧，在1989年的一场球场踩踏事故中，97名利物浦足球俱乐部球迷失去了生命。

stadium.en: A country of 70 million people, and the Prime Minister only received enough votes to fit a small football stadium.
stadium.zh: 一个拥有7000万人口的国家，首相获得的选票只够填满一个小型的足球场。

stadium.en: Yes, so this is all of the energy combined from the 73,000 people in the stadium, jumping in unison and stamping in unison.
stadium.zh: 是的，所以这是体育场内73,000人齐声跳跃和齐声跺脚的所有能量的总和。

strawberry.en: So, is the cream tea debate about: a) whether to drink tea or coffee? b) whether to put cream or jam onto the scone first? or, c) whether strawberry or raspberry jam is better?
strawberry.zh: 那么，关于奶油茶点的争论是关于：a）是喝茶还是喝咖啡？b）是先抹奶油还是先抹果酱到烤饼上？还是c）草莓果酱还是树莓果酱更好？

sticky.en: A well-made sticky toffee pudding is perhaps the best dessert in the world, in my opinion.
sticky.zh: 在我看来，制作精良的太妃糖布丁（sticky toffee pudding）也许是世界上最好的甜点。

sticky.en: British food also has lots of desserts and cakes: sticky toffee pudding, Eton mess, bread and butter pudding.
sticky.zh: 英国食物也有许多甜点 and 蛋糕：太妃糖布丁、伊顿麦斯（Eton mess）、面包黄油布丁。

sticky.en: One of the most useful soils is clay, a dense, smooth soil which is very fertile but sticky.
sticky.zh: 最有用的土壤之一是粘土，这是一种致密、光滑的土壤，非常肥沃但有粘性。

strategic.en: The community was in a strategic position between Eastern and Western Europe.
strategic.zh: 这个社区地理位置优越，处于东西欧之间的战略要地。

strategic.en: But despite these challenges, Istanbul’s strategic position still gives it enormous importance.
strategic.zh: 但尽管面临这些挑战，伊斯坦布尔的战略地位仍然赋予其巨大的重要性。

strategic.en: In Syria, Wagner fought alongside forces loyal to President Bashar al-Assad, securing oil fields and other strategic assets.
strategic.zh: 在叙利亚，瓦格纳与效忠于巴沙尔·阿萨德（Bashar al-Assad）总统的部队并肩作战，保卫油田和其他战略资产。

strategic.en: This was a strategic location that allowed merchants to transport goods and local leaders to collect taxes from passing traders.
strategic.zh: 这是一个战略要地，使商人能够运输货物，当地领袖能够向过往的商人征税。

strategic.en: They function as a tool of Russian foreign policy, extending Moscow’s influence in regions where it has strategic or economic interests.
strategic.zh: 他们充当俄罗斯外交政策的工具，在莫斯科拥有战略或经济利益的地区扩大其影响力。

steady.en: And in return, they provided the animals with a steady source of protein.
steady.zh: 作为回报，人类为这些动物提供了稳定的蛋白质来源。

steady.en: He worked three part-time, not very steady jobs, and made a total of $45,000 a year, roughly.
steady.zh: 他做了三份兼职，工作不是很稳定，总共年收入大约 45,000 美元左右。

steady.en: Without steady employment and a husband to help with bills, Brandy watched anxiously as her household supplies dwindled.
steady.zh: 没有了稳定的工作和帮她分担账单的丈夫，Brandy 焦虑地看着家里的物资一天天减少。

steady.en: Grid engineers call this baseload power: a steady, reliable supply that is always there, whatever the weather.
steady.zh: 电网工程师称之为基荷电力：一种无论天气如何都始终存在、稳定且可靠的电力供应。

steady.en: As for the Carthaginians, they were far from home, with no reinforcements, no steady supply of men or food.
steady.zh: 至于迦太基人，他们远离故土，既没有后援，也没有源源不断的兵源和粮食补给。

steadily.en: And for most of the last twenty years, these buildings have been growing steadily but predictably.
steadily.zh: 在过去20年的大部分时间里，这些建筑一直在稳定但可预测地增长。

steadily.en: It has evolved significantly since then, with power shifting steadily from the monarch to Parliament, through civil wars, reforms, and revolutions.
steadily.zh: 从那以后，它发生了重大的演变，通过内战、改革和革命，权力稳步从君主转移到议会。

steadily.en: Rio slowly developed as a port. The city grew steadily, but there was little reason to think it would become more important than Salvador.
steadily.zh: 里约作为港口缓缓发展。这座城市稳步增长，但当时没什么理由认为它会变得比萨尔瓦多更重要。

steadily.en: I want to bring Hayek in, and when you said--when you were talking about the diffusion of technology and innovation, or in this case it would probably be invention--that allowed, say, a filament to bring illumination relative to whale blubber-- Right-- I've never thought about this before, I think, but when you frame it earlier--as we've been doing and in terms of inevitability versus agency--if you think about the Nordhaus insight, that the price of illumination has fallen steadily over time: It's an emergent order/invisible hand argument.

stretch.en: Why? Why is France stretched across territories thousands of kilometers away from Paris?

stretch.zh: 他们有着紧密的联系。他们拥有延伸数千公里的贸易路线。

stretch.zh: 他们的起源可以追溯到5000多年前，使他们成为世界上最古老的文明之一。

stretch.en: The statue stands on top of Corcovado Mountain, high above Rio, with its arms stretched open wide.
stretch.zh: 雕像矗立在科尔科瓦多山顶，高高俯瞰里约，双臂向两边大大张开。

strap.en: The learner would be strapped into a chair with electrical wiring so they couldn't escape.
strap.zh: “学生”会被绑在一张接有电线的椅子上，无法逃脱。

strap.en: The learner was then taken to an adjacent room and, as the teacher watched, strapped into a chair.
strap.zh: 接着，“学生”被带到隔壁房间，在“教师”的注视下被绑到椅子上。

strap.en: But George had no such luxury. Instead, he was strapped into a jacket and chained to a chair.

strap.zh: 所以他更换了它们。他加了一个新的玻璃镜面、新的指针、新的表带、机芯内部的新弹簧和螺丝，机芯就是让手表运转的部件。

strap.en: Now, he isn’t going to be strapped for cash, in need of money, as between himself and his wife he has a fortune of almost a billion Euros, but it is more a case of damage limitation, and allowing him to move on and get on with whatever his future plans might be without too much personal embarrassment.
strap.zh: 现在，他并不会缺钱花，因为他和妻子拥有近10亿欧元的财富，但这更多是为了止损，让他能够继续前进，开展未来的计划，而不会感到太尴尬。

structural.en: The implication Milgram drew was a call for structural awareness.
structural.zh: 米尔格拉姆由此得出的启示，是呼吁人们建立起对“结构性因素”的清醒认知。

structural.en: It was a structural feature of a law that had grown up as the legal arm of an established Christian state.
structural.zh: 它是作为一个基督教国家的法律臂膀成长起来的法律体系的结构性特征。

structural.en: That's a hypothesis. It's an interesting hypothesis. homeostasis within the human body how we're always returning to a given level of things like that's a that's a fundamental part of our makeup our temperature ph blood pressure and so on under homeostasis but if you if you engage in any kind of signaling like you take a peptide for example that's a signaling molecule you take a hormone externally the body will counteract it you take testosterone the body will counteract it will downregulate its own production very fast and the body releases its own hormones in pulses rather than steady state why is that well that's because bacteria and viruses can infect your body and trick your body they can take it over like toxoplasmosis does this rabies does this they take over macroscopic structure structural bodies and small bacteria and viruses would hack our bodies and literally take them over if we didn't have defense mechanisms and one of those defense mechanisms is homeostasis anytime you see something getting out of whack you immediately push back really hard on because like did i just get infected is something trying to take me over it's also why hormones get released in pulses at night rather than in steady state low levels because enemy bacteria can release toxins or the same signaling molecules in small quantities, but they can't pulse.
structural.zh: 这只是一个假说。这是一个有趣的假说。人体内的稳态，即我们如何始终回归到某种基准水平，这是我们构成的一个基本部分，比如我们的体温、pH 值、血压等等，这些都处于稳态之下。但如果你进行任何形式的信号干预，比如你服用肽类，那是一种信号分子，或者你从外部摄入激素，身体就会进行抵消。你摄入睾酮，身体就会抵消它，并迅速下调自身的产量。而且身体是以脉冲方式而非稳态方式释放自身激素的，为什么呢？因为细菌和病毒会感染你的身体并欺骗它，它们可以接管你的身体，比如弓形虫病会这样做，狂犬病也会这样做。它们接管宏观结构，而微小的细菌和病毒会入侵我们的身体，如果我们没有防御机制，它们甚至会直接接管我们。其中一种防御机制就是稳态：每当你看到某项指标失控，你就会立即进行强力回击，因为你会想：“我是不是被感染了？有什么东西想接管我吗？”这也是为什么激素是在夜间以脉冲形式释放，而不是以稳定的低水平释放的原因，因为敌对细菌可以释放毒素或少量的相同信号分子，但它们无法同步脉冲。

stir.en: The meal is gruel, which is water with a little oatmeal stirred into it.
stir.zh: 饭是粥，也就是水里面搅了一点燕麦片。

stomach.en: They also improve digestion. You just have less food matter going through your stomach.
stomach.zh: 它们还能改善消化。你胃里通过的食物残渣会变少。

stomach.en: The portions are measly, and their stomachs are again rumbling minutes after they have finished eating.
stomach.zh: 饭量少得可怜，他们刚吃完饭几分钟，肚子就又咕咕叫了起来。

stomach.en: And he used to rant and just say, it makes me sick to my stomach the kind of loans that we do.
stomach.zh: 他经常怒气冲冲地说，我们做的这种贷款让我感到胃里翻江倒海。

stomach.en: Why is it that I'm thinking about, well, let's say purchasing a product, but I get a feeling in the pit of my stomach that's a little queasy?
stomach.zh: 为什么会这样：我正在考虑，比方说，买一件商品，却在胃里感到一阵隐隐的不适？

stomach.zh: 随着人类从狩猎转向农业并开始吃更多的面包和谷物，那些能够存活下来的狗，都是其胃部已经适应了吃我们剩饭的狗。

starve.en: So about half a billion people are starving, and a billion people are obese.
starve.zh: 大约有五亿人在挨饿，而有十亿人肥胖。

starve.en: It's all they can think about. Scarcity captures the mind, like it did with those starving men in Minnesota.
starve.zh: 那是他们唯一能考虑的。稀缺抓住了大脑，就像明尼苏达那些挨饿的人一样。

starve.en: Families separated, people starving, diseases spreading through the area.
starve.zh: 家庭离散，人们忍饥挨饿，疾病在区内蔓延。

stumble.en: If you stumbled across someone who was a serious royal watcher, perhaps they could name all 17.
stumble.zh: 如果你碰巧遇到一个狂热的王室观察家，也许他们能说出全部17个人。

stumble.zh: 但在这些事件发生之前，英国人就已经感受到了经济蹒跚和工资增长缓慢。

stumble.en: And those who did agree often found, in the following generations, that they had stumbled into a trap.
stumble.zh: 而那些同意的人往往在后代中发现，他们掉进了一个陷阱。

stumble.zh: 所以我认为，无论你是偶然发现的，还是早就知道，你确实成功地利用了一个非常强大的心理学原理。

stumble.en: You know, who you're with very often is like, well, we were in a relationship, we stumbled along, it felt okay, it had been enough time, so we got married, right?
stumble.zh: 你知道，关于“和谁在一起”，通常是这样的：我们谈恋爱了，顺其自然，感觉还行，时间也够久了，所以我们就结婚了，对吧？

stubborn.en: He was stubborn, certainly; he resisted American independence for longer than was sensible.
stubborn.zh: 他的确很固执；他抵抗美洲独立的时间比理智的做法要长。

stubborn.en: For two days, he lay there, saying only ‘More weight,’ until he died, a stubborn stand against the madness.
stubborn.zh: 他躺在那里整整两天，嘴里只念叨着“再加点重量”，直到死去，这是对狂热的顽强抵抗。

striking.en: What’s striking is how often people say the same things.
striking.zh: 令人震惊的是，人们说的话竟然如此相似。

striking.en: Rather than trying to hold and defend territory, they would move like the desert itself, appearing suddenly, striking hard, and disappearing before the enemy could retaliate.
striking.zh: 他们不应试图占领和保卫领土，而应像沙漠本身一样移动，突然出现，猛烈打击，并在敌人反击前消失。

striking.en: First, it's thought it was through percussion, striking pieces of flint against iron pyrite to create sparks that could catch in a small bundle of tinder: small, dry pieces of wood or leaves.

strip.en: It only occupied a narrow strip of land along the Atlantic coast.
strip.zh: 它只占领了大西洋沿岸的一狭长地带。

stability.en: The government has generally defended these policies by arguing that Singapore needs its stability.
stability.zh: 政府通常通过辩称新加坡需要稳定性来为这些政策辩护。

stability.en: At the same time, the government placed enormous emphasis on stability and bureaucracy.
stability.zh: 与此同时，政府极度强调稳定和官僚体制。

stability.zh: 在这层国际稳定的外表之下，埃及人民正在窒息。

stability.zh: 虽然他们受益于保护和政治稳定，但柏林仍然是一个区域性城市。

strength.en: If you are lucky enough to have a natural strength, some kind of talent, try to build on it.

streamline.zh: 虽然这样一个系统也许能简化记录保存，但你仍然需要一个机制来处理每年大约 0.24 天的多余时间，这个解决方案其实并不比当前的闰年系统更整洁。

stair.en: To quote Putin directly, 'There, on that stair landing, I got a quick and lasting lesson in the meaning of the word "cornered".
stair.zh: 用普京的原话来说：“在那里的楼梯平台上，我上了一堂生动而持久的课，明白了‘走投无路’这个词的真正含义。”

stocking.en: Prisoners wore smocks, which were like long, shapeless dresses, and on their heads, they had to wear a nylon stocking cap.
stocking.zh: 囚犯们穿着罩衫，就像没有版型的长袍，头上还得戴一顶尼龙丝袜帽。

stake.en: This gave Australia a growing economic stake, an economic interest, in the territory.
stake.zh: 这赋予了澳大利亚在该领地不断增长的经济权益和经济利益。

stake.en: People thought John couldn't do it. If you said that today, people would burn you at a stake.
stake.zh: 人们认为John做不到。如果你今天说这个，人们会把你绑在火刑柱上烧死。

stake.en: Many of the knights admitted to these crimes under extreme torture and found themselves burned at the stake, executed publicly.
stake.zh: 许多骑士在极端酷刑下承认了这些罪行，结果发现自己被绑在火刑柱上公开处决。

stake.en: And so what I'll try and do is genuinely, sometimes I'll be, even in a conversation, I practice it when it's low stakes.
stake.zh: 所以我尝试做的是，真诚地，有时我会，即使在谈话中，我也会在风险较低时练习它。

stake.en: In October 1967, the world's greatest chess minds gathered in Sousse, Tunisia, to face off at the Interzonal Tournament, the high stakes gateway to the World Chess Championship.
stake.zh: 1967年10月，世界上最顶尖的国际象棋高手齐聚突尼斯苏塞，参加区际赛——那是通往世界国际象棋锦标赛的高风险门槛赛事。

strife.en: It was a time of economic strife and political instability, which saw two general elections in the same year.
strife.zh: 那是一个经济困难、政治不稳的时代，同年举行了两次大选。

stroll.en: A tall and handsome British man had come into the bank one day and made a large withdrawal, only to stroll across the street and go into another bank.
stroll.zh: 一名高大英俊的英国男子有一天来到银行取了一大笔钱，然后径直穿过马路进了另一家银行。

stroll.en: There is a photograph of him strolling around London with a well-known Czech spy, and there is the testimony of a high-ranking Czech spy, who had no discernible motive to lie.
stroll.zh: 有一张他与一名著名的捷克间谍在伦敦散步的照片，还有一名捷克高级间谍的证词，而那个人并没有明显的撒谎动机。

startle.en: In 2008, a professor at the University of Sheffield published a startling discovery.
startle.zh: 2008年，谢菲尔德大学的一位教授发表了一项令人吃惊的发现。

steak.en: A steak and ale pie or a shepherd’s pie or a Cornish pasty are great.
steak.zh: 麦芽酒牛肉派（steak and ale pie）、牧羊人派（shepherd’s pie）或康沃尔肉馅饼（Cornish pasty）都很棒。

strengthen.en: At the same time, there are significant opportunities for the EU to strengthen itself.
strengthen.zh: 与此同时，欧盟也迎来了巩固自身的重要机遇。

strengthen.en: If a country already has strong institutions, resources might strengthen its economy, like Norway.
strengthen.zh: 如果一个国家已经拥有强大的机构，资源可能会增强其经济，就像挪威一样。

strengthen.en: The basic idea of the testing effect is that trying to remember information strengthens your memory.
strengthen.zh: 测试效应的基本理念是，试图回忆信息会增强你的记忆力。

strengthen.en: Unlike many scientific theories that are replaced or rewritten, Darwin’s work has been consistently confirmed, strengthened and expanded.​
strengthen.zh: 与许多被取代或重写的科学理论不同，Darwin的著作一直得到持续的证实、巩固和扩展。

strengthen.en: But it actually strengthened his image, and he wasn’t the only Member of Parliament to go and run a city.
strengthen.zh: 但它实际上强化了他的形象，而且他并不是唯一一个去管理城市的议员。

static.en: This dramatic event revealed to Darwin that the earth is not static.
static.zh: 这一戏剧性的事件向Darwin揭示了地球并不是静止的。

static.en: It’s static. You have what you have. You can’t improve it.
static.zh: 它是静止的。你有什么样的能力就是什么样的。你无法提升它。

static.en: And that consciousness is relatively static in the sense that it's been exactly the same from the moment you were born to the moment you die.
static.zh: 而那种意识是相对静态的，从你出生那一刻到你死亡那一刻，它完全一样。

standardize.en: So people trust standardized tests like IELTS or the Cambridge English qualifications.
standardize.zh: 因此，人们信任像雅思或剑桥英语证书这样的标准化测试。

standardize.en: This need to prove your English ability has created a demand for standardized English proficiency tests.
standardize.zh: 这种证明自己英语能力的需求，催生了对标准化英语熟练度测试的需求。

standardize.en: This removed barriers to trade, standardized some regulations (which made regulations the same across different countries), and also allowed for the free movement of people and goods and services.
standardize.zh: 这消除了贸易壁垒，统一了一些规章制度（也就是使不同国家的规章制度保持一致），并且允许人员、货物和服务的自由流动。

standardize.en: A decade later, they've fallen to 41st. For all the promises about charter school performance, three quarters of all Michigan charter schools are in the bottom half of all schools as measured by standardized tests.
standardize.zh: 十年后，他们跌至第41位。尽管对特许学校的表现作出了种种承诺，但以标准化测试衡量，四分之三的密歇根特许学校都处于所有学校的后半段。

stabilize.en: The population also stabilized at around 2000 people, mostly living in small towns or villages across the island.
stabilize.zh: 人口也稳定在大约 2000 人，大多居住在岛上的小城镇或村庄里。

stabilize.en: So for example, they wanted to stabilize oil prices.
stabilize.zh: 例如，他们希望稳定油价。

staircase.en: So during the spring and autumn equinoxes, which is when the day and night are equal, the sunlight creates a shadow on the staircase that resembles a serpent, a snake, moving down the pyramid.
staircase.zh: 所以在春分和秋分时节，即昼夜平分的时候，阳光在阶梯上投下阴影，看起来就像一条巨蛇正在顺着金字塔往下爬。

stairway.en: They’re often installed on entrances, on stairways, or on the outside walls facing the street.
stairway.zh: 它们通常安装在入口、楼梯间或面向街道的外墙上。

strive.en: Then you start your bout of suffering or anticipation while you strive to get that thing.
strive.zh: 然后你就开始了痛苦或期待的过程，努力去争取那个东西。

strive.en: How much does it matter that we had Iqbal Quadir or Strive Masiyiwa?
strive.zh: 有没有伊克巴尔·夸德尔或斯特赖夫·马西尤瓦这样的人，真的那么重要吗？

strive.en: Right? And, Strive Masiyiwa, his initial idea--he left the country; he had the opportunity to study in England.
strive.zh: 对吧？说到斯特赖夫·马西尤瓦，他最初的想法是——他离开了祖国，有机会去英国求学。

strive.en: And, you know, we need to strive to heal ourselves.
strive.zh: 而且，你知道，我们需要努力去治愈自己。

standpoint.en: From our standpoint, it's like, there's a guy out there with a lot of money.
standpoint.zh: 从我们的角度来看，就像是，外面有个家伙手里握着一大笔钱。

standpoint.en: And, what constitutes a big idea in economics from the standpoint of the history of economic thought is not a very big idea.
standpoint.zh: 而从经济思想史的角度来看，如今经济学里所谓的“大理念”，其实算不上什么大理念。

standpoint.en: So, I actually never thought I would be interested in looking at baseball from the standpoint of a job, and one of my students, Justin Humphries, used to play baseball for the Houston Astros organization.
standpoint.zh: 所以，我其实从未想过自己会对从一份工作的角度来看待棒球感兴趣，我的一个学生贾斯汀·汉弗莱斯过去曾在休斯敦太空人队组织里打过棒球。

stupid.en: But he felt a layoff was different. He was mad that she'd made a stupid mistake.
stupid.zh: 但他觉得裁员情况不同。他很生气她犯了这么蠢的错误。

stupid.en: How do you make something so good? Everyone feels stupid saying no, which is the sub headline of the book.
stupid.zh: 你怎么能做出这么好的东西？每个人都觉得说“不”很蠢，这是书的副标题。

stupid.en: This lens offers a new way of thinking about why people who find themselves in scarcity seem to do things that to an outsider look stupid.
stupid.zh: 这种视角为思考为什么陷入稀缺的人会做出在外人看来很愚蠢的事情提供了一种新方法。

stupid.en: Man, I feel sorry for you. And when he said that, when he actually played out what my revenge fantasy was in real life, I realized it looked stupid.
stupid.zh: 伙计，我真为你感到难过。当他说出这句话，当他真正演绎出我的复仇幻想在现实中是什么样子时，我意识到这看起来太蠢了。

stupid.en: When it enters your mind, it becomes a problem, whether it's a judgment about the girl walking down the street or the car that just cut in front you or whether it's like, you know, this, your accountant did this stupid thing.
stupid.zh: 当任何事情进入你的大脑，它就变成了一个问题，无论是对街上走过的女孩的评判，还是刚才别你车的车，又或者是你会计做的蠢事。

stagger.en: Meanwhile, a staggering number of Michigan charters are for profit, 80% according to researchers at Western Michigan University.
stagger.zh: 与此同时，据西密歇根大学的研究人员称，密歇根州数量惊人的特许学校是营利性的，高达80%。
